It's a name that instills a sense of radiance and brilliance.

The name is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, success, and good health. Hitin also signifies innate qualities of brightness, intelligence, and resilience. The name is a reminder of the divine within, encouraging one to live a virtuous and enlightened life.
